## Berlin Software Engineer Offer Snapshot

A balanced view for a 4-year software engineer moving to Berlin: **Offer 2** leads on pay and flexibility, **Offer 3** leads on time off, and **Offer 1** is the most balanced middle ground.

## Ranked Offer Comparison

| Rank | Offer | Total Cash Value | Time Off | Work Style | Weekly Load | Why it ranks here |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---|
| 1 | Offer 2 | **EUR 88,200** | 28 days | Remote | 38 hrs/week | Highest cash, best flexibility, lighter weekly load |
| 2 | Offer 1 | **EUR 84,240** | 30 days | Hybrid | 40 hrs/week | Strong all-around balance of pay, PTO, and structure |
| 3 | Offer 3 | **EUR 80,640** | 32 days | Hybrid | 42 hrs/week | Best vacation, but lower pay and highest weekly hours |

## Ranking Framework for Compensation, Flexibility, and Time Off

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/bar-chart-line.svg

### Scoring model
Use a 100-point score with weights that match your priorities:

- **Compensation: 50%**
  - Base salary + bonus
  - Optional adjustment for weekly hours
- **Flexibility: 30%**
  - Remote > hybrid
  - Shorter week scores higher
- **Time off: 20%**
  - More vacation days scores higher

### Practical scoring result
- **Offer 2**: Best if you want the strongest mix of salary and flexibility
- **Offer 1**: Best if you want a safer all-round choice with solid PTO
- **Offer 3**: Best if vacation time matters more than money

### Simple decision rule
- Choose **Offer 2** if maximizing earning potential and remote work matters most
- Choose **Offer 1** if you want the best balance with moderate risk
- Choose **Offer 3** if you value extra vacation and can accept lower pay

## Recommended Chart for Decision-Making

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/graph-up.svg

### Best chart type: Weighted radar chart
Plot each offer across 3 axes:
- **Compensation**
- **Flexibility**
- **Time off**

Why it works:
- Shows trade-offs clearly in one view
- Makes the “best balanced offer” easy to spot
- Useful for comparing offers with different strengths, not just salary

### Suggested chart setup
- Normalize each metric to a 0–10 scale
- Use weights:
  - Compensation = 50%
  - Flexibility = 30%
  - Time off = 20%
- Add a second view as a **bar chart of total cash value** for quick salary comparison

### Normalized score input
- Compensation: base + bonus
- Flexibility: remote = highest, hybrid = middle
- Time off: 32 days > 30 days > 28 days

## Best Fit by Priority

- **Best overall balance:** Offer 1
- **Best pay + flexibility:** Offer 2
- **Best time off:** Offer 3
